<!--
  One entry is one procedure, technique or concept. If you are proposing a
  whole subject area, use the "New Topic" template instead.
  See docs/ENTRIES.md for the writing reference.
-->

## Title

## Domain
<!-- survival | water | agriculture | materials | energy | construction | transport | health | knowledge | society | chemistry | biology | silicon | ship | computers | quantum -->

## Summary
<!--
  What does this entry enable? Two or three sentences, in plain language.
  Not a definition: what the reader will be able to do afterwards.
-->

## Prerequisites
<!--
  What must already be true, known, or built before this entry is useful?
-->

## Materials & Tools
<!--
  Concrete inputs, with sizes, quantities or grades. Note the substitutions
  that are acceptable and the ones that are not.
-->

## Procedure outline
<!--
  The main steps, in order. A maintainer may ask for the full write-up in a
  pull request instead.
-->

## Sources
<!--
  The sources you have actually read, with their licences. Public domain,
  CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, or original work. If you have not read a source yet, say
  so here rather than in the entry.
-->

## Safety Level
<!-- green | yellow | red -->
<!--
  Grade it by the worst credible outcome, not by how careful the reader is.
  For red, state what training, supervision, equipment and authorisation the
  work needs.
-->

## Difficulty
<!-- novice | apprentice | journeyman | master -->
<!-- Grade it by the hardest step, not by the first one. -->

## Local knowledge
<!--
  Anything you know from practice that is not in a published source, and
  where it applies. This is often the most valuable part of a proposal.
-->

## Anything else
